canonical_rule: adapters/** translates private provider, protocol, process, CLI, HTTP, WebSocket, importer, and framework schemas behind Gateway sockets; adapters must not own Gateway policy, Shell presentation state, Kernel authority, Orchestration planning, Validation scoring, Observability storage truth, route admission, payload budgets, or permission decisions.

legacy_debt_management.purpose: Prevent declared non-translator adapter exceptions from becoming permanent compatibility infrastructure.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy dashboard host until Gateway physical re-root completes.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: A dashboard host under adapters can imply adapters own Gateway/Shell hosting authority.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Move remaining host entrypoint and lifecycle callers to gateway/runtime/**, then retire the adapter path.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy dashboard asset host; not a provider/framework translator.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Asset serving under adapters can preserve Shell hosting authority outside Gateway.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Route dashboard asset serving through the canonical Gateway runtime/static route and leave adapters translator-only.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy setup/onboarding helper outside the stable adapter translator role.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Setup workflow logic under adapters can turn the adapter domain into an onboarding authority owner.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Move setup/onboarding routing to installer or Gateway-owned onboarding code, or delete the helper if unused.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy CLI module barrel; should shrink as canonical commands move to domain owners.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: A CLI barrel under adapters can hide non-translator command authority in the adapter domain.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Resolve callers to canonical domain command modules and delete the barrel once no imports remain.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy binary discovery helper; process discovery policy should eventually live under Gateway/Core-owned launch surfaces.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Binary discovery under adapters can blur translator code with host launch policy.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Move process/binary discovery policy to Gateway launch or Core ops authority and keep adapters as provider translators.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy ops process bridge; durable ops authority must become Core/ops receipted.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: An ops process bridge under adapters can hide durable system action authority outside Core receipts.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Route ops process execution through Core ops receipt paths and remove the adapter bridge.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy ops lane bridge; retained as explicit debt while resident/core receipts replace fallback behavior.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Ops lane bridging under adapters can preserve fallback mutation authority outside receipted Core lanes.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Replace remaining callers with resident/Core ops receipt calls and remove the adapter lane bridge.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy runtime-system bridge; not a pure external translator.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Runtime-system bridging under adapters can make adapters look like runtime authority owners.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Move runtime-system dispatch to Core runtime-system authority paths and keep adapters translator-only.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: A Kernel bridge under adapters can imply adapters can reach or mirror Kernel authority.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Move remaining compatibility imports to canonical Kernel/Gateway contracts and delete the adapter wrapper.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy memory bridge compatibility wrapper; canonical memory truth must remain outside adapters.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Memory bridge code under adapters can blur external translation with canonical memory truth.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Route memory/context access through canonical context-topology or Gateway projection contracts and delete this wrapper.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: An Orchestration surface barrel under adapters can make adapters appear to own planning/workflow exports.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Point callers at Gateway runtime contracts or canonical orchestration exports, then remove the adapter barrel.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: A swarm bridge barrel under adapters can preserve orchestration/swarm authority in the wrong domain.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Re-home callers to canonical swarm/orchestration boundary exports and retire the adapter barrel.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Legacy bridge compatibility under adapters can mask non-translator behavior as an adapter concern.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Identify active imports, move them to canonical Gateway/Core contracts, and remove the compatibility wrapper.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Desktop Shell bridging under adapters can reintroduce Shell/Gateway coupling outside sockets.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Route desktop Shell behavior through Gateway sockets/projections and delete the adapter bridge.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy demo entrypoint, not a stable adapter translator.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Demo entrypoints under adapters can become accidental long-lived runtime surfaces.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Move any still-useful demo to validation/examples or delete it if no longer needed.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Dev-only fallback utilities under adapters can leak into production-like runtime expectations.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Keep only explicitly dev-gated harness utilities and move/delete anything used by production launch paths.

declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.reason: Legacy Orchestration compatibility implementation under adapters; must not expand.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.risk: Legacy orchestration implementation under adapters can recreate cognition/planning ownership in the adapter domain.
declared_legacy_non_translator_paths.next_removal_step: Freeze expansion, move active behavior behind canonical orchestration/Gateway seams, and remove this compatibility tree.

forbidden_translator_signals.detail: Translator files must not own HTTP route admission/projection.
Translator files must not host Shell/Gateway sockets.
Translator files must not own host lifecycle authority.
Translator files must not depend on Shell implementation or presentation state.
Translator files must not import Kernel authority internals directly.
Translator files must not import Orchestration planning internals directly.
Translator files must not own Gateway policy or boundary doctrine.

signal_exemptions.reason: Standalone external skill adapter scripts may exit their own CLI process; they still must not own InfRing host lifecycle, Gateway routes, payload budgets, or permission policy.
